theme: load backpressure LOADAVG NPROC ISATTY admit busy throttle

tests.name: busy_probe
tests.cmd: busy hit when over; no under REQUIRE→2

weaknesses.title: SYS NUM non-numeric returns OK=1 LAST_N=0
weaknesses.detail: NUM "nope" / "1x" / "" succeed with zero. Agents cannot distinguish bad input from zero without digit-check. cut ARG1=nope silently becomes auto-cut 0.

weaknesses.title: LOAD1 string vs LOAD1_N centiload dual plane
weaknesses.detail: LAST is "1.60 1.16 1.20"; LOAD1_N is 160. Agents comparing LOAD1 to NPROC without _N mis-scale by 100x.

weaknesses.title: cut=0 means auto nproc*100 not absolute zero
weaknesses.detail: No way to set "never busy" vs "auto" without sentinel. Agent wanting cut 0 (always admit) collides with auto.

weaknesses.title: Integer division load1/nproc loses fractional ratio
weaknesses.detail: 160/4=40; cannot express 1.60 load per CPU as float. Backpressure bands coarse.

weaknesses.title: ISATTY under selftest/run always non-TTY
weaknesses.detail: Cannot positive-test interactive branch in automated runs without real TTY inject.

weaknesses.title: No soft-fail path for LOADAVG on exotic hosts
weaknesses.detail: Proof assumes always OK; no documented miss semantics for containers without /proc/loadavg.

workarounds: Digit-check ARG before NUM; reject non [0-9]+
Always use LOAD1_N not LOAD1 for compares
Use cut=1 for force-busy tests; huge cut for force-allow
ISATTY tests accept both 0/1; branch on value
Document auto cut as nproc*100 centiload
